cards.title: Hour 14 is a concentrated error spike
cards.detail: Hour 14 recorded 1,460 errors on 9,225 requests, an error rate of 15.8%, versus 31 errors on 8,899 requests in most other hours. This single hour accounts for 67.3% of the 2,169 weekly errors and warrants incident investigation.

cards.title: Caller-07 has unusually high cost per request
cards.detail: Caller-07 spent $174.12 on 1,180 requests, or $0.1476 per request, about 9.0 times the overall average of $0.0164. Review its model routing, payload size, and retry behavior.

cards.title: Caller-01 drives half of weekly spend and traffic
cards.detail: Caller-01 generated 105,832 requests, 51.6% of total volume, and spent $1,643.86, 49.0% of the $3,354.82 total. It should be the primary target for volume, quota, and budget controls.

cards.title: Low cache-hit callers represent a sizable traffic segment
cards.detail: Ten callers account for 44,951 requests, 21.9% of total volume, while their cache hit rates range from 3.7% to 8.9%; the other callers generally report hit rates above 82.3%. Inspect cache-key consistency and cache configuration for callers 03, 05, 07, 09, 11, 13, 15, 17, 21, and 23.

cards.title: Model-alpha has the highest latency at substantial scale
cards.detail: Model-alpha has the highest listed p95 latency at 2,454 ms while handling 86,080 requests and $1,409.02 in spend. Review its capacity and routing, or assess whether some traffic can move to lower-latency models.
